cypher_pattern: MATCH (n:BrodyMemoryDoc {id: $node_id}) SET n.tags = [t IN n.tags WHERE t IS NOT NULL] + [t IN $tags_to_add WHERE NOT t IN n.tags]
fallback_cypher: MATCH (n:BrodyMemoryDoc {id: $node_id}) SET n.tags = [t IN n.tags WHERE t IS NOT NULL] + [t IN $tags_to_add WHERE NOT t IN n.tags]
rollback_pattern: MATCH (n:BrodyMemoryDoc {id: $node_id}) SET n.tags = [t IN n.tags WHERE NOT t IN $tags_added]
rollback_note: Removes only tree_id and family_id added by this write. Never deletes nodes.
